palettes.comment: Drawn to the full 300 m, thinning out evenly from 45 m (distanceFalloff 0.15), 2026-10-15: hard render distances (90 m, copies to 30/60 m) gave extreme pop-in in GreenKeeper. Green is the bulk, straw/brown the accent (Marcus 2026-10-15): in every tall rough mix the green items have distance copies (the carpet item to 15 and 30 m, the other green items to 30 m; each copy thins from 15% of its distance, so about 3x at 3 m and 1x at 30 m, no line) and their tints were moved 6 deg toward green and 15% darker, toward the ground mesh as rendered (hue 67, value 0.3), for a better blend and less pop-in. The accents have no copies and keep their tints. Bright accents thin out only from 70% of the draw distance (their own distanceFalloff 0.7, Marcus 2026-10-22): VSP culls a tuft whole, so from 45 m they popped in one by one; from 210 m a tuft is a few pixels. Same day: tall green 30% darker in linear light (#59784f/#657551 -> #4a6542/#556243): lit by the sun its long arching blades read pale against the mesh and its 30 m copy pops in between 4.5 and 30 m.
